topic: regret of what you didn't do
lines: #At the end of it all, you won't regret the things you *tried.*
The person you never told how you *felt.*
The trip you kept putting off until it was *too late.*
The dream you talked yourself *out* of.
#When you try and it doesn't work, at least you *know.*
#But when you never try, you're left with one question *forever.*
And what if hurts more than *no.*
#So whatever it is you've been too scared to *do*...
#Because one day, you'll be older, looking back at *tonight.*
And you'll either be glad you *went* for it.
Or you'll wonder what *could* have been.
end: Send this to someone sitting on a dream.

cover.sub: You won't regret what you think

post.title: You'll Regret What You Didn't Do
post.caption: Failure hurts for a while. Regret can follow you for years. 🌅
post.first_comment: What's the 'what if' you're done living with? 👇
